finalFight.title: Final Fight One
verifiedWindows: Guy approaches the alley group, strikes at close range and a target is thrown back.
Guy makes a series of grounded contacts followed by a visible airborne kick.
The later outdoor alley exchange shows changing attacker and target poses between contacts.
The room encounter shows distinct contacts, movement resuming, and the hit target falling away.

mappingDecision.nintendo: ARMS is the only Nintendo game among three main moving examples. The two ARMS recordings count once.
mappingDecision.exactLegacyExamples: Final Fight One is the licensed portable edition of the beat 'em up, not the original arcade capture. The detailed position, interpolation and multiplier claims use our own models. Marth's sword-tip example and the differing Ryu/Kazuya styles are retained in explanation without presenting other games' engine internals as measured data.
